GPT-2-like pre-LN decoder whose FFN is a soft MoE routed by hyperbolic distance to learned slot centroids (cdm_lm_distill_qwen27b.py).
- Embedding: tok_embed + learned pos_embed (max_seq 512), then an extra embed LayerNorm (use_embed_norm=True), dropout (:620-660). lm_head tied to tok_embed (:640-641); final LayerNorm. LayerNorm eps 1e-5 default.
- Attention: torch nn.MultiheadAttention (fused biased in_proj, biased out_proj), bool causal mask, no RoPE (:574-607).
- Router (DualGeometryCDMRouter :315-530): x_tan = normalize(h)*0.3, x_hyp = clip_to_ball(exp_map_0(x_tan,c)); K=8 slots s_hyp = clip_to_ball(exp_map_0(slots_tangent,c)) (slots are a BUFFER updated by EMA when training=True); logits = -poincare_dist(x_hyp,s_hyp,c)*exp(clamp(log_temp,log .5,log 20)); c = 0.25+3.75*sigmoid(theta_c) (learned); + beta_tele*telepathy_scale*(prev_layer_gate @ W_tele) (layers>0; telepathy_scale defaults to 0 at inference, so it is OFF in the author's eval); softmax over K, slot probs summed into 4 experts via slot_to_expert = k % 4 (:389-470).
- Experts: SwiGLU down(silu(gate x)*up x), no bias, d_ff 3072; ALL experts evaluated, weighted sum (dense soft MoE) (:532-572). No shared expert.
- Residual: x + attn(LN1 x); x + moe(LN2 x).

grt.forward_vs_parent:
Novel 'Geometric Rotation Transformer': no weight matrices; every projection is a chain of content-modulated Givens rotations. Only the attention plumbing (causal SDPA, KV cache, scale head_dim**-0.5) is llama-like (modeling_grt.py:336-453).
- Embedding: token = exp(clamp(log_magnitude,-5,5)) * interleaved (cos,sin) of hidden/2 learned phase angles (:124-176).
- Position: learnable log-frequency ladder (base pos_freq_base), interleaved-pair rotation applied ONCE to the embedding stream before block 0 (rope_placement='stream', default) (:178-221, 1163-1168); 'qk' option rotates per-head q/k instead.
- Norm: PearlNorm = x / sqrt(mean over pairs of (x_2i^2+x_2i+1^2) + 1e-8) * scale (no mean-centering, RMS of pair radii = sqrt(2)*RMS) (:57-73).
- Attention: Q/K/V/O are per-head chains of n_qkv_rotations stages: butterfly permutation, angle = base + tanh(normalised Cl(2,0) features @ coupling), rotate pairs, multiply by softplus(scales), un-permute (:263-334, 336-453). MHA, no GQA, no qk-norm.
- Cross-head mixer block (n_mixer_rotations) as an extra pre-normed residual branch (:456-597).
- FFN: zero-pad to intermediate_size, rotation chain, RadialGELU (pair scaled by gelu(r)/r, erf GELU), rotation chain, truncate (:614-751); MoR (grt-30m-mor): ffn_n_experts=4 rotation chains mixed by a rotational cosine router, dense softmax when mor_top_k None.
- Residuals: x + g*branch with g = 0.55+0.45*tanh(raw) ('bounded_depth') for attn, mixer, ffn (:753-840); optional peri-LN / per-block PearlNorm (off in configs).
- Final PearlNorm; lm head = cosine similarity of L2-normalised hidden with unit (cos,sin)/sqrt(hidden/2) table (phase angles tied to the input embedding), times softplus(output_scale) (:842-944, 1192-1253).

Simple Attention Network (cites architecture.py):
- Embedding * sqrt(d_model) (668,699); tied output head, optionally truncated to out_vocab, fp32 logits (717-728); no final lm_head matrix.
- Norms: zero-centred RMSNorm (1+scale)*x/rms, eps 1e-6 (25-34).
- mHC residual: 4 lanes (stream broadcast x->[B,T,4,D]); per layer: nx=RMS(flatten lanes); h_pre=sigmoid(a_pre*nx@phi_pre+b_pre+lane offset), layer input u=sum h_pre*lanes; h_post=2*sigmoid(...); lanes <- Sinkhorn(20 iters)(a_res*nx@phi_res+b_res) @ lanes + h_post*(Block(u)-u) (121-126,404-421,480-494); output = mean over lanes then final ZC-RMSNorm (541-548). Fixed lane offsets pre_off=8*onehot(l mod 4)-4, post_off=-4*(1-onehot).
- Block: optional Engram injection at engram sites: x += sigmoid(rms(x).rms(k_e)/sqrt(d)) * v_e, where (k_e,v_e) come from hashed 2/3-gram lookup tables (hash heads, slots 18432, sub_dim 128) -> key/value projections, value passed through a 4-tap dilated causal conv (97-160,349-353,684-695). Then x = x + sigmoid(attn_gate_scalar) * ZCNorm_post(Attn(ZCNorm(x))) (360-364); x = x + HadamardMLP(ZCNorm(x)) (366-370).
- Attention: GQA 12/2, qk_head_dim 48, v_head_dim 64; q/k/v each pass a 3-tap depthwise causal conv over time (184-202); per-head ZC-RMSNorm on q,k (208-209); split-half RoPE over the full qk head dim, theta 1e5 (56-70); scale 1/sqrt(qk_head_dim) (223,246); output gate sigmoid(gate_proj(x_in)) per channel before out_proj (257-260). Sliding window 1024 on all layers except global_layers 4,9,14,19 (full causal) (470-477,396-397).
- HadamardMLP (no dense FFN): pad to power of 2, z = H3( d4 * ... ) with three Kronecker-factored Walsh-Hadamard transforms (learned factors initialised to Walsh), diagonal scales d1..d4, bias b2, fixed seeded permutations, SiLU, and a rank-8 softmax conditioning cond = 1 + softmax(x@V)@U (298-329).

Folded set (hadamard.json weight_names): q/k/v/o, linear_attn in_proj_qkv / in_proj_z / out_proj, mlp gate/up/down, lm_head. in_proj_a/b, norms, conv1d, A_log, dt_bias are untouched.
Token embedding is a latent table: after the row lookup apply the inverse h = s*(H z) (runtime.py:43-59; llama-graph.cpp:2727-2733; only token_embd allowed as inverse table).
Since H*H=I and D*D=I, W_f(H(Dx)) = Wx: logits equal the base model's for the dequantised W. No extra embedding rows, scales, positions or heads; MTP disabled (components.mtp=false).
Version 2 / tied_output (Glimpse-C1-2B, tie_word_embeddings=true) reuses the latent embedding as output head with the forward transform (llama-model.cpp:2325-2334).

Text forward is exactly transformers' Qwen3.5 text model: VLXSeek1_5Model builds language_model = Qwen3_5TextModel._from_config(config.text_config) (modeling_vlx_seek_1_5.py:36) and calls it with inputs_embeds/position_ids unchanged (303-311); VLXSeek1_5ForCausalLM applies an untied bias-free lm_head(text hidden -> vocab 248182) to the last hidden state (329, 471-474), the same as Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration. The config class is Qwen3_5Config with only model_type changed (23-27).
What the wrapper adds is input-side only: the stock Qwen3.5 vision tower is replaced (self.visual=None, 35) by an OmChat/LLaVA-style vision tower + mm_projector ('identity') whose features are masked_scatter'ed into image-token positions (41-63, 161-171); object/region tokens get RoI features from a C-RADIOv4 aux tower via object_vp_extractor + mm_projector_aux, written into VLX_SEEK_1_5_OBJECT_FEATURE_TOKEN_INDEX positions (65-133, 180-221); convert_input_ids expands image placeholders to T*H*W/4 tokens (338-428). Position ids come from Qwen3.5's compute_3d_position_ids (interleaved MRoPE, partial rotary 0.25) (293-301). Training-only 0*dummy feature terms (223-280) do not change values. For text-only input the forward equals Qwen3_5ForCausalLM on text_config.
vlx_seek_1_5.engine_vs_reference: No engine port of the wrapper; inner qwen3_5_text is supported by vLLM/SGLang/llama.cpp/MLX as Qwen3.5. Repo ships NPU fla shims (npu_fla*.py) for Ascend, not compared.

zaya1_vl.forward_vs_parent:
Text decoder = legacy ZAYA1 (inner 'zaya', transformers-main models/zaya) with the same math: CCA attention (q/k linear -> 2-stage causal depthwise+grouped conv over time + (q+k)/2 mean residual, v = [val_proj1(x_t), val_proj2(x_{t-1})], per-head L2 norm to sqrt(head_dim), k *= learned temp) (modeling_zaya1_vl.py:676-895), partial RoPE 0.5 (64 of 128 dims), theta 1e6 from rotary_base (configuration:99,158-170; modeling_zaya1_vl.py:904-928), GQA 8q/2kv, scale 1/sqrt(head_dim) (modeling_zaya1_vl.py:1030); ResidualScaling (h+b)*s and (res+b)*s before each add, none on residual for layer 0 (modeling_zaya1_vl.py:1512-1531, 1435-1443); MoE: 16 SwiGLU experts top-1 + MoD skip class, router = down_proj 2048->256 + EDA (prev router state * scale, layers>0) + RMSNorm + 3-layer GELU MLP, softmax, argmax of probs+balancing_biases (skip bias -1), expert output * prob (modeling_zaya1_vl.py:1534-1662, 1862-1950); final res_scale + final_norm (modeling_zaya1_vl.py:2423-2432); tied lm_head, no logit scale (modeling_zaya1_vl.py:2753-2757, 2850).
What the VL wrapper adds to the text forward:
- Image features: Qwen2.5-VL ViT (32 blocks, merger out 2048 = LM hidden, no extra projector) replace <image> token embeddings via masked_scatter (modeling_zaya1_vl.py:2751, 2812-2836).
- Vision-only LoRA: image_mask = (input_ids == image_token_id) is threaded to every layer; on image-token positions only, low-rank addends are added to q, k (rank 8) (modeling_zaya1_vl.py:787-792), v1/v2 (modeling_zaya1_vl.py:870-877), o_proj output (modeling_zaya1_vl.py:1050-1053), and in every expert to fc1 output and fc2 output (rank 32) (modeling_zaya1_vl.py:1755-1758, 1794-1797, routed through the sort in 1916-1930). Router ignores image_mask. Text tokens (and all decode steps / text-only prompts, where mask is None) follow the plain ZAYA1 path exactly.
- Positions are plain 1D cache positions (no M-RoPE) (modeling_zaya1_vl.py:2365-2369).
Differences vs the transformers-main zaya port (legacy semantics kept here): (a) MoD skip tokens get expert_output = normed_hidden * p_skip (identity path) (modeling_zaya1_vl.py:1934, 1946), whereas transformers-main zeroes them (modeling_zaya.py:561-563, 600-601); SGLang zaya.py:1179-1187 matches the legacy identity path; (b) residual stream not forced to fp32 (config residual_in_fp32=false) vs fp32 in main (modeling_zaya.py:455, 761); (c) router RMSNorm eps 1e-6 (layernorm_epsilon default, modeling_zaya1_vl.py:1583) vs rms_norm_eps 1e-5 in main; router MLP under CUDA bf16 autocast (modeling_zaya1_vl.py:1640); (d) q/k norm without clamp_min (modeling_zaya1_vl.py:883-887) vs clamp_min(finfo.eps) (modeling_zaya.py:272-277).
zaya1_vl.engine_vs_reference: No engine port of zaya1_vl (vLLM/SGLang/llama.cpp/mlx-lm have text 'zaya' only; 1bit-MONSTER GGUF repo has README only). For the inner text model, SGLang zaya.py keeps the legacy MoD identity path; vLLM zaya.py:387-389 and transformers-main zero skip tokens.
